contexts.text: Punishment on account of no reception of these goods, is signified by the palmerworm devoureth the olive trees ().

I will compensate to you the years that the locust hath consumed, the beetle, and the bruchus, and the palmerworm (): it is evident that falsities and evils in the extremes, that is, in the external Sensuous of the man of the Church, are signified by these kinds of insects.
Become chrysalises, aurelias, erucae, nymphs, and at last butterflies.
Like a field devastated by erucae and locusts.
The palmerworm () = the falsity which destroys. ( = the falsity which destroys good. AE 638:20.)
3. [end]. The case of a worm, with the eruca and the butterfly from it.
